::: {.feature-card}
### NAT Traversal

Expose localhost and private APIs to cloud AI agents through SSH tunnels. No public endpoint required.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### REST → MCP Auto-Wrap

Point NyxID at any REST endpoint. It generates an MCP Server automatically.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Credential Injection

Your agents never touch raw API keys. NyxID's reverse proxy auto-injects credentials at the network layer.
:::

## Why Chrono AI

NyxID is our first product. We are building the infrastructure stack for the AI agent era.

::: {.stack-section}
```
NyxID  (connectivity + identity)     ← NOW
  └── Ornn  (skill marketplace)      ← NEXT
       └── Aevatar (agent runtime)   ← LATER
```

**NyxID** — Open-source Agent Connectivity Gateway. Connect any service to any AI agent, with built-in credential security.

**Ornn** — Skill-as-a-Service platform. Create, discover, and execute AI agent skills.

**Aevatar** — Distributed agent runtime. Host persistent AI agents in the cloud.
:::
